name: SimpleShear
description: Preprocessor for a simple shear box model. The packing initially conforms a gas-like, very loose, state (see utils.makeCloud function), but importing some existing packing from a text file can be also performed after little change in the source code. In its current state, the preprocessor carries out an oedometric compression, until a value of normal stress equal to 2 MPa (and a stable mechanical state). Others Engines such as KinemCNDEngine, KinemCNSEngine and KinemCNLEngine, could be used to apply resp. constant normal displacement, constant normal rigidity and constant normal stress paths using such a simple shear box.

attributes.name: thickness
attributes.description: thickness of the boxes constituting the shear box [$m$]

attributes.name: length
attributes.description: initial length (along x-axis) of the shear box [$m$]

attributes.name: height
attributes.description: initial height (along y-axis) of the shear box [$m$]

attributes.name: width
attributes.description: initial width (along z-axis) of the shear box [$m$]

attributes.name: matYoungModulus
attributes.description: value of FrictMat.young for the bodies [$Pa$]

attributes.name: matPoissonRatio
attributes.description: value of FrictMat.poisson for the bodies [-]

attributes.name: matFrictionDeg
attributes.description: value of FrictMat.frictionAngle within the packing and for the two horizontal boundaries (friction is zero along other boundaries) [$^ circ$] (the necessary conversion in [$rad$] is done automatically)

attributes.name: gravApplied
attributes.description: depending on this, GravityEngine is added or not to the scene to take into account the weight of particles

attributes.name: timeStepUpdateInterval
attributes.description: value of timeStepUpdateInterval for the TimeStepper used here

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Generate scene, save to given file

methods.name: load
methods.description: Generate scene, save to temporary file and load immediately
